translationRepairs: Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent his younger brother Li Hu with an army to oppose him.
Learning that the Emperor had succeeded, the Empress Dowager sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with an army to oppose him.
太弟 is Li Hu's formal title, not kinship to the new emperor; apposition and capitalization make that distinction clear in English.
When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent his younger brother Li Hu with troops to resist him.
When the Empress Dowager heard the Emperor had succeeded, she sent Li Hu, the Imperial Younger Brother, with troops to resist him.
The literal must preserve 太弟 as Li Hu's formal title without implying that he was the newly enthroned emperor's brother.
He executed Minister of Agriculture Huashe and Chubuli.
He executed Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Minister of Agriculture; translating the office is clearer than leaving the title as Situ.
Minister of Agriculture Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
Minister over the Masses Huashe and Chubuli were put to death.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses, not Minister of Agriculture; translating the office is clearer than leaving the title as Situ.
